title: Wikis
intro: Publish the minutes of each session as a page in Notion or Confluence. Each meeting then picks its wiki in Settings › Integrations.
name: Name

hints.notion: In Notion, create an internal integration at notion.so/profile/integrations and copy its secret. Then open the parent page and share it with the integration (••• › Connections): pages are created under it.
hints.confluence: Confluence Cloud: an API token created at id.atlassian.com, for the account whose email is above. Data Center or Server: a personal access token (profile › Personal access tokens), without an email. The account must be able to create pages in the space.

tokenKept: A token is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Meetings stop publishing there; the pages already published stay in it.

meeting.title: Publish the minutes
meeting.intro: At each archive, the minutes become a page of the wiki, named by the session's date. When the summary is edited, the page follows.
meeting.hint: Sessions already archived are published from the history.
meeting.noWiki: No wiki in this workspace yet.
meeting.addWiki: Add one in the workspace settings
meeting.on: The minutes will be published to {name}.
meeting.off: The minutes are no longer published.

errors.token: The wiki refused the token: check that it is right and still valid.
errors.notionPage: Notion cannot find the parent page: share it with the integration (••• › Connections).
errors.notionParent: The parent page is not the address of a Notion page.
errors.confluenceSpace: Confluence cannot find the space or the parent page, or the account cannot see them.
errors.network: The wiki could not be reached: check its address.
